5317-through-the-magic-door.title: Through The Magic Door
5317-through-the-magic-door.creator: Arthur Conan Doyle
5317-through-the-magic-door.description: A book by Arthur Conan Doyle. e thoughtful, here are the kings of thought. If he be dreamy, here are the masters of fancy. Or is it amusement that he lacks? He can signal to any one of the world’s great story-tellers, and out comes the dead man and holds him enthralled by the hour. The dead are such good company that one may come to think too little of the living.

68133-the-history-of-the-proceedings-in-.title: The History Of The Proceedings In The Case Of Margaret Commo
68133-the-history-of-the-proceedings-in-.creator: Unknown
68133-the-history-of-the-proceedings-in-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. There being no history with which every learned reader is better acquainted in general, than that of John Bull, and his sister Peg, we shall spend very little time in preambles or introductions to the present story.

arxiv-2105-04584.title: Calibration of mid- to far-infrared spectral lines in galaxies
arxiv-2105-04584.creator: Sabrina Mordini ,, Luigi Spinoglio ,, Juan Antonio Fernández-Ontiveros ,
arxiv-2105-04584.description: Abstract Context. Mid- to far-infrared (IR) lines are suited to study dust obscured regions in galaxies, because dust extinction is strongly decreasing with wavelength and therefore IR spectroscopy allows us to explore the most hidden regions of galaxies, where heavily obscured star formation as well as accretion onto supermassive black-holes at the nuclei of galaxies occur.

arxiv-2109-15133.title: Least-Squares Finite Element Method for Ordinary Differential Equations
arxiv-2109-15133.creator: Matthias Chung, Justin Krueger, Honghu Liu
arxiv-2109-15133.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Matthias Chung, Justin Krueger, Honghu Liu. We consider the least-squares finite element method ( lsfem ) for systems of nonlinear ordinary differential equations, and establish an optimal error estimate for this method when piecewise linear elements are used.

arxiv-2201-09672.title: PH-Net: Parallelepiped Microstructure Homogenization via 3D Convolutional Neural Networks Journal: Additive Manufacturing
arxiv-2201-09672.creator: Hao Peng, An Liu, Jingcheng Huang, Lingxin Cao, Jikai Liu, Lin Lu
arxiv-2201-09672.description: Abstract Microstructures are attracting academic and industrial interests with the rapid development of additive manufacturing. The numerical homogenization method has been well studied for analyzing mechanical behaviors of microstructures; however, it is too time-consuming to be applied to online computing or applications requiring high-frequency calling, e.g., topology optimization.

arxiv-2308-09917.title: Learning Multiscale Consistency for Self-supervised Electron Microscopy Instance Segmentation
arxiv-2308-09917.creator: Yinda Chen, Wei Huang, Xiaoyu Liu, Shiyu Deng, Qi Chen, Zhiwei Xiong
arxiv-2308-09917.description: Abstract Instance segmentation in electron microscopy (EM) volumes is tough due to complex shapes and sparse annotations. Self-supervised learning helps but still struggles with intricate visual patterns in EM. To address this, we propose a pretraining framework that enhances multiscale consistency in EM volumes.

arxiv-2405-02396.title: Geometry, Dissipation, Cooling, and the Dynamical Evolution of Wind-Blown Bubbles
arxiv-2405-02396.creator: Lachlan Lancaster, Eve C. Ostriker, Chang-Goo Kim, Jeong-Gyu Kim, Greg L. Bryan
arxiv-2405-02396.description: Abstract Bubbles driven by energy and mass injection from small scales are ubiquitous in astrophysical fluid systems and essential to feedback across multiple scales. In particular, O stars in young clusters produce high velocity winds that create hot bubbles in the surrounding gas.

arxiv-2409-18816.title: Modern Portfolio Diversification with Arte-Blue Chip Index
arxiv-2409-18816.creator: Simon Levy, Maxime L. D. Nicolas
arxiv-2409-18816.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel approach to evaluating blue-chip art as a viable asset class for portfolio diversification. We present the Arte-Blue Chip Index, an index that tracks 100 top-performing artists based on 81,891 public transactions from 157 artists across 584 auction houses over the period 1990 to 2024.

arxiv-2411-01314.title: Filling some gaps on the edge coloring problem of split graphs
arxiv-2411-01314.creator: Fernanda Couto a, Diego Amaro Ferraz b , Sulamita Klein b
arxiv-2411-01314.description: Abstract A split graph is a graph whose vertex set can be partitioned into a clique and an independent set. A connected graph G G is said to be t t -admissible if admits a spanning tree in which the distance between any two adjacent vertices of G G is at most t t .

arxiv-2501-15159.title: Reproducing Λ \Lambda CDM-like Solutions in f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) Gravity: A Comprehensive Study Across All Connection Branches
arxiv-2501-15159.creator: Saikat Chakraborty, Jibitesh Dutta, Daniele Gregoris, Khamphee Karwan, Wompherdeiki Khyllep
arxiv-2501-15159.description: Abstract Given the remarkable success of the Λ \Lambda CDM model in fitting various cosmological observations, a pertinent question in assessing the phenomenological viability of modified gravity theories is whether they can reproduce an exactly Λ \Lambda CDM-like cosmic background evolution.

arxiv-2510-08641.title: Interlaced dynamic XCT reconstruction with spatio-temporal implicit neural representations
arxiv-2510-08641.creator: Mathias Boulanger, Ericmoore Jossou
arxiv-2510-08641.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the use of spatio-temporal Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) for dynamic X-ray computed tomography (XCT) reconstruction under interlaced acquisition schemes. The proposed approach combines ADMM-based optimization with INCODE, a conditioning framework incorporating prior knowledge, to enable efficient convergence.

arxiv-2510-14613.title: The multimessenger view of Pulsar Timing Array black holes with the Horizon-AGN simulation
arxiv-2510-14613.creator: Hippolyte Quelquejay Leclere, Kunyang Li, Marta Volonteri, Stanislav Babak, Ricarda S. Beckmann, Yohan Dubois, Clotilde Laigle, Natalie A. Webb
arxiv-2510-14613.description: Abstract We use the Horizon-AGN cosmological simulation to study the properties of supermassive black hole binaries (MBHBs) contributing most to the gravitational wave background (GWB) signal expected in the pulsar timing array (PTA) band. We develop a pipeline to generate realistic populations of MBHBs, allowing us to estimate both the characteristic strain and GWB time series observable by PTA experiments.

Furthermore, it is unclear to what degree other forcings, inclu

pmc-10735552.title: MATERIAL DEPRIVATION AND LONELINESS AMONG OLDER ADULTS IN HONG KONG
pmc-10735552.creator: Vivien Foong Yee Tang, Kee Lee Chou
pmc-10735552.description: Given that poverty as a risk factor on loneliness is understudied, this study examined the relationship between material deprivation and loneliness of older adults in Hong Kong, the mediation effects of social support and social network, and the moderation effects of social support and social engagement.

pmc-11640837.title: Effects of Physical Exercise on Emotional Intelligence from Birth to Adolescence: A Systematic Review Protocol
pmc-11640837.creator: Falonn Contreras-Osorio, Enrique Cerda-Vega, Christian Campos-Jara, Rodrigo Ramirez-Campillo, Nuria Pérez-Romero, Michela Di Trani
pmc-11640837.description: Background: Emotional intelligence (EI) can be understood as a set of traits or abilities that may have an impact on academic, professional, or mental health. The aim of this protocol was to establish methodological guidelines for a systematic review and meta-analysis of the effects of acute and chronic physical exercise on EI from birth to 21 years (late adolescence).

pmc-12404436.title: Understanding perceived value in tourism: Insights from destinations facing crises
pmc-12404436.creator: Laurent Yacoub, Samer ElHajjar, Youssef Zgheib, Nada Jabbour Al Maalouf
pmc-12404436.description: Tourism is a significant contributor to global economic growth, underscoring the importance of understanding visitors’ perceptions of attractions in destinations that face challenges and crises. This study investigates key factors influencing tourists’ perceived value of a destination, using the context of such challenging economic and political crises.

pmc-12472576.title: Antihypertensive Effect of a Self-Microemulsifying System Obtained from an Ethanolic Extract of Heliopsis longipes Root in Spontaneously and L-NAME-Induced Hypertensive Rats
pmc-12472576.creator: Dailenys Marrero-Morfa, Beatriz A Luz-Martínez, Francisco J Luna-Vázquez, Carlos T Quirino-Barreda, Isela Rojas-Molina, Martín García-Servín, Pedro A Vázquez-Landaverde, Victoria Ruiz-Castillo, César Ibarra-Alvarado, Alejandra Rojas-Molina, Stela Dimitrova, Ana M Dobreva, Petko Denev
pmc-12472576.description: Arterial hypertension is a major contributor to cardiovascular disease, the leading cause of death globally. Previously, our research group has demonstrated that both organic extracts from Heliopsis longipes roots and affinin—its principal bioactive compound—induce vasodilation and exert antihypertensive effects in L-NAME-induced hypertensive rats. However, the poor water solubility of these extracts limits their oral administration and dosing.

pmc-12822249.title: Mentorship needs and satisfaction of MD-PhD and MD-MSc trainees with marginalized identities: the Canadian experience
pmc-12822249.creator: Zaid A M Al-Azzawi, Mimosa Luigi, Charles Yin, Ehsan Misaghi, Robert X Lao, Bryce J M Bogie
pmc-12822249.description: Physician-scientists (PS) are the backbone of translational research and groundbreaking medical developments in many developed countries. Formalized PS training programs in the form of MD-PhD/MD-MSc programs in Canada have had a longstanding tradition of producing many exceptional PS researchers, staff, and faculty.

pmc-13145011.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2031 PLASMA BIOMARKERS IN DELAYED CEREBRAL ISCHEMIA AFTER ANEURYSMAL SUBARACHNOID HEMORRHAGE
pmc-13145011.creator: Karmen Aslankurt, Roel Haeren, Rick Van Lanen, Hanna Schenck, Sander van Kuijk, Erik Gommer, Yasin Temel, Onno Teernstra, Jim Dings, Inger de Ridder, Michael Veldeman, Marcel Aries, Hans Vink
pmc-13145011.description: Background and aimsAn aneurysmal subarachnoid haemorrhage (aSAH) is a life-threatening neurovascular emergency. Among survivors of the initial insult, the most feared complication is Delayed Cerebral Ischemia (DCI), affecting approximately 30% of aSAH patients. Several mechanisms responsible for DCI development have been described. We have recently hypothesized that the endothelial glycocalyx plays a key role in these pathomechanisms.

pmc-13218265.title: Molecularly self-assembled nanoplatforms for targeted ROS-scavenging and neuroinflammation alleviation in acute ischemic stroke
pmc-13218265.creator: Xianru Bi, Meng He, Wenxuan Cao, Li Xiang, Dong Liu, Liangbo Sun, Jiqin Lian, Xia Li, Lu Lu
pmc-13218265.description: Cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury (CIRI) poses a pivotal barrier to neuronal survival after successful recanalization in acute ischemic stroke. This phenomenon involves multiplexed pathophysiology where oxidative stress-neuroinflammation cascades critically drive neuronal death. Although antioxidative and anti-inflammatory agents hold therapeutic promise, their clinical translation is impeded by insufficient blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetration and the challenge of simultaneously regulating multiple pathological pathways.

pmc-13571665.title: Amphiregulin shapes mitochondrial delivery and immune modulation by microvescicles
pmc-13571665.creator: Giuseppe Prencipe, Adrián Cerveró-Varona, Alessia Peserico, Angelo Canciello, Verdiana Di Giulio, Hélder A. Santos, Antti Tuhkala, Chika Takano, Toshio Miki, Valentina Russo, Maura Turriani, Oriana Di Giacinto, Barbara Barboni
pmc-13571665.description: SummaryAmniotic epithelial cells (AECs) exert potent paracrine immunoregulatory functions, yet whether inflammatory cues enhance the biological activity of their extracellular vesicles (EVs) remains unclear. To address this question, we characterized the secretome of ovine AECs under basal and lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated conditions using label-free proteomics and genetic approaches.

pmc-13709615.title: QTL mapping for target leaf spot resistance in a Japanese-type cucumber
pmc-13709615.creator: Minh Thi Ho, Ruikun Chen, Sachiko Isobe, Kenta Shirasawa, Yosuke Yoshioka
pmc-13709615.description: Target leaf spot (TLS), caused by Corynespora cassiicola, is among the most economically important diseases of cucumber (Cucumis sativus L.). Because of the rising incidence of disease problems, much effort has been put toward resistance breeding. Here, we investigated the inheritance of high TLS resistance in a Japanese–type inbred line.
